title: 第六十四章 活活撕碎你三章第六十七章 老夫林玄今日没人可以活着
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 轰！
林玄的速度快到极点。
瞬间冲来，撕碎空气，发出尖锐刺耳的呼啸，好似一颗恐怖的导弹一样。
几十米的距离，几乎一秒钟都不要。
那尖锐可怕的虎爪拳，直接向着狼人的面门狠狠刺去。
原因无他！
这怪物竟然在高速愈合！！！
是的！
他原本碎裂的手臂、血肉模糊的爪子，在砸在地上之后，居然以一种肉眼可见的速度在愈合。
这让他不禁想到前世一些有关狼人的传说。
这种东西，可不就是掌握超速愈合吗？
那狼人脸色痛苦，几乎还没反应过来，就眼瞳一骇，整个面门再次遭遇到了林玄倾力恐怖的一击。
砰！
好似一个高速飞射而来的大铁锤狠狠砸在了他的面门一样。
他整个身躯直接被打得从地上激飞而起。
半边面孔都直接炸了，一颗眼球瞬间粉碎。
红的白的，四处飞舞。
整个脑海嗡嗡作响，能够清晰听到里面的脑液流动声音。
他的眼前一片赤红。
整个世界都好像变红了。
痛苦、恐惧、愤怒、癫狂...种种混乱情绪瞬间交织到一起。
几乎在第二次倒飞的刹那，他的整个就再次发生改变。
那一身原本只是浓郁的黑毛，但这一刻，竟突然间统统覆盖上了一层森森血光，一股狂躁、暴虐，难以想象的恐怖气息直接从他的身上爆发而出。
浑身上下的血管也突然间再次膨胀、变大，一处处血肉全都鼓了起来。
血脉狂暴！！！
为了能够活命，狼人俨然动用了自己种族的最强神通。
因为他要是再不用，今日绝对会被对方活活打死！
血脉狂暴下，他的力量和速度，都会瞬间飙升。
但这【血脉狂暴】也有极大限制。
那就是一旦动用，便会敌我不分，只剩下战斗本能。
倘若对方直接逃走，那他也不知道该锁定谁。
只会到处乱杀！
而一旦等狂暴结束后，他也会陷入极其恐怖的虚弱之中。
但眼下他已经没有选择！
林玄给他带来的压力太大了！！！
content_en:
boom!
Lin Xuan's speed was extremely fast.
It rushed forward in an instant, tearing up the air and making a sharp and ear-piercing roar, like a terrifying missile.
A distance of tens of meters takes almost no time.
The sharp and terrifying tiger claw fist stabbed directly towards the werewolf's face.
There is no other reason!
This monster is healing at a high speed! ! !
Yes!
His shattered arms and bloody claws actually healed at a speed visible to the naked eye after they hit the ground.
This reminded him of some legends about werewolves in his past life.
Isn't this kind of thing about mastering super-speed healing?
The werewolf had a painful expression on his face, and before he could even react, his eyes flashed with shock, and his entire face was once again struck by Lin Xuan's terrifying blow.
Bang!
It was like a large hammer flying at high speed hit him hard in the face.
His entire body was directly hit and flew up from the ground.
Half of his face exploded, and one eyeball shattered instantly.
Red and white, flying everywhere.
The whole mind was buzzing, and the sound of brain fluid flowing inside could be clearly heard.
His eyes were red.
The whole world seemed to turn red.
Pain, fear, anger, madness...all kinds of chaotic emotions were instantly intertwined.
Almost the moment he flew upside down for the second time, his entire being changed again.
His body was originally just thick black hair, but at this moment, it was suddenly covered with a layer of blood, and a manic, violent, and unimaginable aura of terror erupted directly from his body.
The blood vessels all over his body suddenly expanded and became larger again, and the flesh and blood bulged everywhere.
Bloodline rages! ! !
In order to survive, the werewolf seemed to have used the strongest magical power of his race.
Because if he doesn't use it anymore, he will definitely be beaten to death by the other party today!
Under the violent blood flow, his strength and speed will instantly soar.
But [Bloodline Fury] also has great limitations.
That is, once it is used, it will no longer distinguish between ourselves and the enemy, only the fighting instinct will remain.
If the other party escaped directly, he wouldn't know who to target.
Just killing everywhere!
And once the rage ends, he will fall into an extremely terrifying weakness.
But now he has no choice!
Lin Xuan put too much pressure on him! ! !
"Ouch!!!"
title_en: Chapter 64: Tear you alive Chapter 3 Chapter 67: Old husband Lin Xuan, no one can survive today
